scope: Three source root causes only. Generated artifacts, configuration, suppression settings, dependencies and unrelated pre-existing work unchanged.

rootCauses.name: Redundant grid breakpoint membership check
rootCauses.evidence: Both branches selecting keys use breakpoints.keys or a filtered subset. Every selected key is already a valid breakpoint; internal traversal callbacks do not mutate the keys. The indexOf position was used only as membership, not as an index.
rootCauses.impact: Tiny repeated work during responsive grid styling. No known visible failure and no claimed live page-speed improvement.
rootCauses.fix: Remove the already-proven membership check without constructing another collection. Preserve ordering, undefined filtering and style append behavior. Leave the separate filterBreakpointKeys lookup unchanged.
rootCauses.tests: Three traversal tests pass before/after: small and large object branches, unknown/undefined keys, order, arrays, scalar and empty inputs. Two existing real grid SSR style tests also pass.
rootCauses.memory: No new Set, Map, cache or allocation added. Existing keys allocation remains unchanged; no heap improvement claimed.

rootCauses.name: Google Form field configuration complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk from duplicated required-error and label/style configuration across input branches. No known user-facing failure.
rootCauses.fix: Extract shared field props and apply required/error configuration once; retain text/select/checkbox/date rendering, module-scope dynamic boundary, option order and filtering.
rootCauses.tests: Nine tests pass before and after, covering all six supported field types, frozen options, empty option labels, placeholder/label choice, required errors, multiline rows, variant and date input styling.

rootCauses.name: Gallery layout configuration complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance risk from mixing responsive layout defaults with gallery/lightbox behavior. No known user-facing failure.
rootCauses.fix: Extract cohesive gallery style calculation. Keep lightbox state, handlers, item keys, link selection and dynamic component ownership in the gallery.
rootCauses.tests: Four tests pass before/after: standard/masonry default and override columns, aspect ratio, explicit variant precedence, spacing/row height, link versus lightbox behavior, item dimensions, lightbox persistence and closing, empty gallery.

recipeReview: Fetched via curl with Cache-Control: no-cache and Pragma: no-cache; read evidence, false-positive and fix recipes. No Set conversion without amortization evidence. Removed a logically redundant membership test instead. Complexity fixes separate cohesive configuration without moving state/effects or adding nested components. Read installed Next lazy-loading documentation and React best-practices skill.
lookupReview: Google Forms script HTML includes() and settings path includes() are substring searches, not array membership, so left unchanged. Any-tag paths remain unchanged after prior benchmark concerns. No blanket lookup conversion or suppression.
grouping: Three independent roots. Grid file retains its distinct first-stage filtering lookup; only the redundant second-stage membership root is fixed.

benchmark.method: Transpile actual before/after grid source, execute traverseBreakpoints with equal-output assertions, 10000 warmup calls and median of 15 batches of 20000 calls. Includes existing key selection and style allocations. Synthetic representative grid inputs, not live-site traces.
benchmark.interpretation: Two normal responsive scenarios improved slightly; undefined-only scenario differed by +0.141 ms per 20000 calls (about 7 ns per call), too small to establish a meaningful regression. This is an optional redundant-work cleanup, not a demonstrated production performance defect.

validation.lint: Six changed source/test files pass with zero errors/warnings
validation.overallCount: 64 to 61; exactly the three selected source removals. Generated diagnostics unchanged.
validation.limitations: No production build or browser visual comparison. Gallery tests mock rendering boundaries; grid SSR tests use the actual grid. React Doctor completes with exit 1 because other findings remain.

remaining.followUp: Review remaining complexity and lookup findings individually; preserve string-search semantics and require evidence before changing small-array or any-tag lookups. Other warnings and generated artifacts left alone.
